en.title: Services will be paused soon
description: Services will be temporarily paused from May 9 to May 25 due to participation in a military exercise.

et.title: Teenused peatatakse peagi
description: Teenused peatatakse ajutiselt vahemikus 9.–25. mai seoses osalemisega kaitseväe õppusel.

en.title: Services are paused
description: Services will be unavailable from May 9 to May 25 due to participation in a military exercise. You are still welcome to send messages, but responses will be provided after returning from the exercise.

et.title: Teenused on pausil
description: Vahemikus 9.–25. mai ei toimu teenuste pakkumist. Põhjuseks on osalemine kaitseväe õppusel. Kirju võib endiselt saata, kuid neile vastatakse pärast õppuselt naasmist.
